_comment: 复制需要的条目到 hooks.json。command hook：stdin=JSON；exit 0 通过；exit 2 拦截（stderr 给模型）；其它 exit 记笔记不拦截。

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('command',''); sys.stderr.write('blocked dangerous rm\n') if 'rm -rf /' in cmd else None; sys.exit(2 if 'rm -rf /' in cmd else 0)"

PreToolUse.command: node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); const p=(d.tool_input&&d.tool_input.path)||''; if(/\.env($|\\.|\\/)/.test(p)){console.error('deny .env write'); process.exit(2)} process.exit(0)"

Stop.command: node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8')); if(d.changed_files&&d.changed_files.length&&!d.did_verify){console.error('Stop: verify before finish'); process.exit(2)} process.exit(0)"

Stop.message: Stop blocked: files changed but agent_verify not run.
